Settings.Title: Settings
Layout.Title: Desktop controls
Layout.Description: Move the header, pager, summary, hint, group badge and notifications, and drag a corner grip to resize them.
Layout.ResetToast: Layout reset to the default positions and sizes.
Appearance.IconSizeDesc: Choose how large desktop items appear. Smaller tiles fit more items on each page.
Appearance.AutoIconToast: Icon size follows the density preset.
Appearance.TextSizeDesc: Scales headings, labels, buttons and the desktop icon names.
Appearance.ColorsDesc: Choose a theme or fine-tune every colour in the overlay.
Appearance.ResetColorsToast: All colors reset to the default look.
Style.PanelDescription: Pick a theme, then fine-tune any colour.
Appearance.WallpaperDimDesc: Darkens the wallpaper behind the icons. 0% keeps it untouched.
Grid.FitDesc: Let the app choose how many columns and rows fit.
Grid.SpacingDesc: Adjust the horizontal and vertical gaps between icons. Larger values fit fewer icons per page.
Sorting.FoldersFirstDesc: Keep folders above files when sorting.
Sorting.ShowHiddenDesc: Include hidden and system items from the desktop.
Groups.Description: Create, rename and reorder your own categories. Add file types to sort matching icons automatically. Icons stay where they are on disk.
Groups.Hint: Edit a name or its file types; use the arrows to reorder. Files whose suffix matches a group join it automatically. Right-click icons to override, then choose Group by → Custom to show these groups in the page bar.
Groups.ExtensionsHint: Type a suffix such as pdf and press Add, or choose a file to copy its type. The first matching group wins.
Groups.FileNamesHint: Matches files and folders whose name contains one of these words. File extensions are ignored.
Groups.FolderDialogHint: Only folders whose name contains one of these words join. Matching is case-sensitive. Skip to include every folder.
Groups.FolderAllConfirmMessage: Choosing All folders removes the other filter tags and includes every folder.
Groups.FolderNamesHint: Type a name fragment, for example work. Matching is case-sensitive.
Groups.TypeBrowse: Choose a file to add its type
Groups.ReorderHint: Drag a group to move it.
Groups.NoSelection: Create a group on the left to start.
Behavior.AlwaysShowDesc: Keep the header and the page bar visible instead of fading them out.
Behavior.CloseToTrayDesc: Keep Desktop Drawer running when the window is closed.
Behavior.StartWithWindowsDesc: Open Desktop Drawer automatically after sign-in.
Behavior.LoggingDesc: Save a log file in %AppData%\DesktopDrawer for troubleshooting. Off by default.
Windows.HideNowDesc: Temporarily hide the icons on the Windows desktop while you use Desktop Drawer.
Windows.HideOnLaunchDesc: Automatically hide the Windows icons whenever Desktop Drawer starts.
Windows.RestoreNote: Desktop icon visibility is restored when Desktop Drawer exits.
About.Text: Your desktop files, spread across calm, page-sized views. Files stay exactly where they are.
